name: 94565 · Pittsburg, CA
findings: ZIP 94565 (Pittsburg) has 227 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94565 (Pittsburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94565 (Pittsburg) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
